newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Normandy extends North Flinders bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Normandy extends North Flinders bid.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Monday it had extended the closing date for its takeover offer for North Flinders Mines Ltd by a month to December 18.
Normandy has a 74.1 percent interest in North Flinders.
It had about 50 percent of the gold miner before it made the bid earlier this year. Normandy's offer is 425 Normandy shares for every 100 North Flinders shares.
North Flinders shares closed 10 cents higher at A$7.80 and Normandy shares ended two cents up at A$1.69 on Monday.
